question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the existing inline bounded composer plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds another composer mode whose draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics are product/UX decisions rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build the modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current bounded inline composer plus modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt solution and close or narrow this request.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build the modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior review context for this issue.
